vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-82417
vulnerability.description: qs: qs.stringify throws a TypeError when serializing certain crafted inputs

statements.action_reference: backend/package-lock.json bump via `npm update qs` (transitive of body-parser/express/superagent)
statements.impact_statement: Transitive dep of body-parser (^6.15.2), express (^6.14.0), and superagent (^6.14.1); all parent ranges are semver-compatible with 6.16.0. Ran `npm update qs` in backend/, lockfile now pins qs@6.16.0. Verified: 445/445 backend unit tests pass; 38 integration tests skipped (env-gated) as on main.

statements.action_reference: backend/package-lock.json bump via `npm update qs` (transitive of body-parser/express/superagent)
statements.impact_statement: Same transitive path as CVE-2026-82417; the 6.16.0 release contains fixes for both advisories. Backend lockfile now resolves qs to 6.16.0 in a single node_modules/qs entry. Verified: 445/445 backend unit tests pass.
